title: Hynek at Project Blue Book, opposed then repented

tellings.quote: you have Jaylen Heinik who was opposed but then you know later retracted all of that stuff and kind of repented for the fact that he was opposed.

plain: Michels says that J. Allen Hynek, the astronomer who advised Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, at first argued against UFO reports but later took all of that back and "kind of repented for the fact that he was opposed." Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. It matters because it would mean the Air Force's own scientist changed his mind about the subject.
